manglish.name: Manglish
manglish.about: Malaysia's everyday English, mixed freely with Malay, Cantonese, Hokkien and Tamil words and finished with lah, lor, meh and ah. Spoken at the mamak, in the office and on WhatsApp by everyone in KL.
